reviews.t: I have always been disappointed when I find a Moringa seed oil that is ...
reviews.x: I have always been disappointed when I find a Moringa seed oil that is a lot cheaper than more expensive moringa oils on Amazon. I am sorry but I don't believe this is 100% pure Moringa oil. I think it is blended with some other oil. The slight nutty smell of pure moringa oil is not there.  It is more liquidy and does not absorb as fast as pure moringa oil.

reviews.t: Great dry-oil moisturizer that stops acne and acne scars

I am African American, and this moisturizer/acne treatment makes my skin dewey, radiant; gives me vibrant skin tone; is non-greasy; and prevents acne. I use it after I have washed and toned my skin with toner. I am using My Doctor Suggests Silver Soap and Probiotic Action sprayable probiotics for acne and rosacea for my cleanser and toner, respectively. Inn& Co Moringa Oil smells like Thyme. reviews.t: Love this and use it daily for face moisturizer
reviews.x: Love this and use it daily for face moisturizer. Is the best remedy for hemorrhoids I've ever found..  period.

I absolutely LOVE this oil!!! I use it for multiple purposes with excellent results. I add a little to some baking soda for a weekly gentle exfoliant--Amazing!!! I add a few drops to my lotions-incredible!!! I have even added a few drops to my conditioner. My husband and I have applied it directly to achy or painful areas and it works amazingly well at relieving the pain. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.t: I have used this for both my hair and skin ...
reviews.x: I have used this for both my hair and skin. It absorbs quickly, doesn't leave an oily feel or residue (remember to use only a little) and has left my skin soft and my hair shiny. I've also massaged it into my cuticles and rubbed it on dry spots on my feet. Would definitely purchase again.

reviews.t: Love it. It truly nourishes and hydrates
reviews.x: Love it. It truly nourishes and hydrates. It even gives me that dewey tacky to the touch feeling which is amazing because we lose that as we age.

I am very impressed with this Organic Moringa Oil. It has a very slight but engaging smell which is earthy, enticing, and invigorating. I became intrigued after reading about the many benefits of Moringa oil so I decided it might be worth trying. I ordered from Inn & Co because their Moringa oil is 100 % organic. You can get more or less by changing how hard you pump. I have been using the oil for about three months, mostly on my skin, occasionally on my hair as a pre-shampoo treatment. It is quickly absorbed and does not leave the skin greasy and shiny. My skin is definitely improved. I like the woody smell of it.  I hope I will never be w

I’ve been using this product for a couple months. I use it on my face and hands morning and night. Smells awful so I put a few drops of lavender oil in the bottle. My skin is so soft! Small lines are gone. My skin is so supple. I’ve used everything from Okay to La Mer and I’ll be using this for a while. I used to have these little white bumps on my forehead almost like whiteheads and those are gone. I’ve also noticed my pores are smaller.

reviews.t: This oil revived my dry natural hair!
reviews.x: I wish I wasn't frugal and hadn't taken a break from this product for a few months bc I was wondering why my hair looked like a parched tree for the last few weeks. I just used this again with my leave in conditioner and the moistness and shine were finally back. It combats the negative effects of hard water. This moringa oil literally revived my hair which is curly and type 3b/c. Yay!

I apply the oil to my face and hands at night, before bed. In the morning, I have noticeably softer, smoother skin. I have also used it on a patch of eczema on my scalp. It doesn't itch nearly so badly now!
I use this oil for my skin and hair care.  It is a carrier oil that carries a punch, since it contains a lot of vitamins as well as antibacterial properties.  I am pleased with my purchase.

reviews.t: I have used it in my hair (4c natural) and my hair responds wonderfully to it
reviews.x: I'm enjoying this oil immensely. My skin is clearing up and it feels so soft. I have used it in my hair (4c natural) and my hair responds wonderfully to it.
Does have a very funny smell, but  it does a wonderful job with my daughter's hair

I really do like this oil. It does have a strange nutty scent but it doesn't linger and it's tolerable. You could add an essential oil to it to change the scent also. It melts into skin and hair so smoothly and doesn't leave a greasy film. I purchased this oil because of the health and beauty benefits associated with it. It can be used for facial and body skin as well as hair. I would definitely repurchase because it seems to be a really high quality oil for the price and the amount you get is g

I really like this oil. I bought it because I started to get eczema flare ups and it would calm but leave crusty scab like patches but this oil helps clear it up and my skin feels and looks like regular skin. I also like it for my face, I have dry skin but I also get super oily in some areas, this helps with both problems .

Very nice oil. It smells earthy like burdock and it smoothes my skin without leaving it greasy looking. I like the glass pump bottle as you get small drops in just the right amounts for your face without having excess all over your hands.
Not pure moringa oil. Doesn't absorb on the skin and leaves your face oily. Broke me out!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the oil as an effective moisturizer that leaves skin soft, smooth, and hydrated.
Many customers report using it successfully for both hair and skin, noting it absorbs well and adds shine or softness.
Several reviewers describe the smell as unpleasant or off-putting, comparing it to spices or calling it awful.
A few customers question the product's purity or quality, citing a missing nutty scent, a rancid batch, or lack of an organic label.
Some reviewers find the oil a bit heavy for their preference.
